title: Terraria Starter Tools
description: Players spawn in with unbreakable copper tools.
body:
_Terraria Starter Tools_ is a quality-of-life data pack that gives players a sword, pickaxe, and axe upon spawning in. This helps speed up tedious, repetitive early progression by skipping wooden and stone tools. These copper tools are also unbreakable, meaning they will last until you no longer need them.

This data pack can also be used as a resource pack, which will change the appearance of the starter tools to match that of Terraria's. Crafted copper tools will maintain their default Minecraft appearance.


## Technical

A player must be in survival mode, will be granted a hidden advancement, and the starter tools are a reward given as loot.

The starter tools cannot be enchanted.
